Questions

Before you book

Can I book online?

Yes. Just Beautiful takes bookings through Square Appointments. Open the booking page, or call the salon.

I'm not sure what I want. Where do I start?

Start with a consultation. The salon's whole approach is figuring out what your hair needs before anything else.

Who will be doing my hair?

Tiffany. Just Beautiful is a one chair salon.
